events.title: Breck Sky Fest 2026 — Inaugural Free Public Telescope Stargazing in Frisco and Breckenridge
events.time: Friday November 27, 5:30–7:30 PM MST (Frisco); Saturday November 28, 6:00–7:30 PM MST (Breckenridge); each session requires its own free RSVP.
events.location: Nov 27: Frisco Historic Park, 120 E Main St, Frisco, Colorado; Nov 28: Breckenridge Ski Resort, Quicksilver chair base area, Breckenridge, Colorado, USA
events.cost: Free telescope sessions, $0 per person, $0 for family of five; separate RSVP required for each night. Parking, transport, food extra and not confirmed. Separate VIP stargazing at Beaver Run costs $57/person and is not included.
events.age: General public, families and visitors of all ages; children remain with accompanying adult, no residency or membership prerequisite stated; RSVP required with group size, live capacity not confirmed.
events.description: First-edition Breck Sky Fest organized by AstroTours.org with Town of Breckenridge grant support; an unusual limited festival, not the organizer's regular paid $57 astronomy tour. Public astronomer-led direct telescope viewing, constellation pointing and only brief talks, free and flexible drop-in. Two confirmed public nights at distinct locations Nov27 and Nov28; each has its own $0 RSVP at https://breckskyfest.com/rsvp/frisco/ and https://breckskyfest.com/rsvp/breck/. Organizer confirms $0 admission, exact times and venues and first-year grant in https://breckskyfest.com/about/. Dates apply to 2026 local Colorado friends; not 2027–2028 visiting family. Weather postponement or cancellation possible. No proof of subscriber delivery or of collector database miss.
